subject.title: Policy: add authored routing binding conformance checks

question: Should the bundled Policy plugin adopt routing-binding probes as a supported, attested `policy.jsonc` contract, and what stable redaction and match-result semantics should that contract guarantee?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear, but adding a top-level policy namespace makes the authored probe format, evidence content, and long-term compatibility promise a maintainer-owned product contract.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow Policy extension
options.body: Add an opt-in routing namespace limited to configured-binding presence checks and redacted `resolveAgentRoute` probe expectations, with no core routing behavior changes.

options.title: Keep routing verification external
options.body: Decline a bundled Policy schema addition and recommend an operator-owned script until a broader routing-policy contract is desired.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow Policy extension
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in routing namespace limited to configured-binding presence checks and redacted `resolveAgentRoute` probe expectations, with no core routing behavior changes.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history signal for the bundled Policy plugin and its original conformance/Doctor design.
